blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified cUSDO implementation blocks a sender when underlying USDO.isBanned(from) is true and blocks transfers while either USDO or cUSDO is paused. At finalized Solana slot 433002244, the Token-2022 mint assigns the same system-account signer as both mintAuthority and freezeAuthority, so that signer can freeze individual Solana token accounts.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: cUSDO has a native Ethereum wrapper and native Solana Token-2022 route, while Base, BSC, and Kaia are peripheral representations built on Chainlink CCIP USDO underneath plus OpenEden cUSDO ERC-4626 wrappers. cUSDO itself has no token-level CCIP pool: inherited USDO bridge controls are scored here. The external-validated-network tier is inherited from USDO's Chainlink CCIP route.

controls.label: cUSDO Kaia underlying USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1
controls.evidence: At Kaia block 226390775, the directory-listed pool returned getToken() = 0x87e617c7484ade79fcd90db58beb82b057facb48, typeAndVersion() = USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1, owner() = 0x19902b456e57224aecbe9ad8827cff50a05b73ae, and getRouter() = 0x4eb2a60af37bc6bb05500f581c00e8ea3075f6e9. This pool supplies the inherited USDO burn/mint route; the local cUSDO wrapper holds that USDO. Owner authority type, remote peers, and current rate-limit buckets were not established in this observation.

controls.label: cUSDO Base underlying USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The Base USDO BurnMintTokenPool exposes remote-pool and peer configuration for the Ethereum CCIP lane; returned remote-pool byte arrays were not decoded in this pass.
routeChecks.rateLimits: At Base block 50064777, inbound and outbound rate-limit buckets for the Ethereum CCIP selector were enabled. The pool owner EOA can change these route bounds.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The pool reports typeAndVersion() = USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1, owner() = 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88, and router 0x881e3a65b4d4a04dd529061dd0071cf975f58bcd; the owner administers this bridge pool while Chainlink CCIP validation remains an external route dependency.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: The inherited USDO CCIP burn/mint path is constrained by CCIP message and source-pool accounting; local cUSDO shares are then minted only against Base USDO in the ERC-4626 wrapper. This is not independent native cUSDO issuance.

controls.capDescription: The Base USDO BurnMintTokenPool provides the inherited CCIP burn/mint route. Its enabled inbound and outbound rate limits are bridge controls, not a native cUSDO supply cap.
bypassSurfaces: The shared OpenEden owner EOA can administer the Base pool's peers and rate limits; CCIP validation and source/destination pool accounting remain route invariants, while cUSDO wrapper administration is separately scoped.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50064777, pool 0x500d4882938020e939a5666c1b4200873da7efd3 reported typeAndVersion() = USDO BurnMintTokenPool 1.5.1, getToken() = 0xad55aebc9b8c03fc43cd9f62260391c13c23e7c0, owner() = 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88, and router 0x881e3a65b4d4a04dd529061dd0071cf975f58bcd. Enabled inbound and outbound rate-limit buckets for the Ethereum CCIP selector were observed. The pool is the inherited USDO bridge route underneath Base cUSDO; cUSDO's local ERC-4626 share accounting is not a token-level CCIP mint path.

controls.label: OpenEden cUSDO Base representation UPGRADE_ROLE/DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE/PAUSE_ROLE EOA

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Base block 50064777, this no-bytecode EOA held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE on the Base cUSDO wrapper. Verified cUSDO source makes UUPS _authorizeUpgrade() require UPGRADE_ROLE; no timelock was observed. These are representation-token controls, not native cUSDO mint authority.

controls.capDescription: The shared OpenEden EOA can replace Base cUSDO wrapper logic or pause/administer the representation immediately; this does not itself create Base USDO supply.
controls.evidence: At Base block 50064777, 0x5eaff7af80488033bc845709806d5fae5291eb88 had no bytecode and held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADE_ROLE, and PAUSE_ROLE on Base cUSDO. The verified UUPS wrapper requires UPGRADE_ROLE for _authorizeUpgrade() and no timelock was observed. This control governs the Base representation only; Ethereum native wrapper upgrade authority remains in Mint Authority.
